sources.title: Tlsmartin/mocov3-experiment · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview This repository is a compact, custom PyTorch implementation of Mocov3 for Classification. The giant configuration is intended for code review, smoke tests, and small controlled experiments rather than as a production-ready pretrained release.
